observations.behavior: Adds four new fields to MultipartConfig: concurrency, range_part_size, range_concurrency; the resolve and resolve_with methods now accept these and use environment variables DELTALITE_MULTIPART_CONCURRENCY, DELTALITE_RANGE_GET_PART_SIZE_BYTES, DELTALITE_RANGE_GET_CONCURRENCY. The multipart wrapper and multipart view wrapper are updated to pass the whole config instead of individual
observations.posthog_connection: This could support PostHog's warehouse ingestion or warehouse-backed queries if PostHog uses deltalite and its Rust backend, allowing concurrent multipart uploads and ranged reads. The change could help throughput and reduce latency, but no PostHog-specific configuration or adoption is shown.
